id_and_class.summary: Kashmir Shaivism holds that Consciousness (chit), identified with Shiva, is the fundamental reality, and that the individual soul (jiva) is one with it. This Consciousness is never inert: its own power (Shakti) makes it vibrate (spanda) and unfold through 36 principles (tattvas) from pure awareness down to physical matter. The world is therefore a real, divine play of Consciousness, and liberation is recognizing that one's own awareness is Shiva.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as Shiva's Self-Aware, Creative Vibration

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is Supreme Consciousness (paramashiva), a dynamic unity of awareness (chit) and power (shakti) that is both transcendent and immanent, the formless ground and source of all forms.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Mind and matter are both stages in the emanation of Consciousness, with physical matter at the far end of the 36 tattvas. Nothing, including the body, is separate from Consciousness.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (Consciousness is ultimate; matter emanates from it)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Consciousness is reflexively self-aware, since Shiva knows himself through Shakti. The individual subject is universal Consciousness that has forgotten its identity, and recognition restores it.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Shiva as Supreme Consciousness; Shakti as its inseparable creative power; spanda as the first vibration of awareness; 36 tattvas as ontological principles of emanation; individual souls identical with Shiva.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Consciousness is self-luminous and contains knowledge within itself, so it is the ground of every act of knowing. It is known by self-recognition.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Thirty-six tattvas, ordered stages of emanation running from pure consciousness to physical matter.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Universal consciousness; individual selfhood; creation of the world; ignorance and liberation.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Spanda, the pulsation of Consciousness driven by Shakti, which sets off creation and unfolds it through the tattvas.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Consciousness is inherently dynamic: it vibrates, creates, and expresses itself as the world through stages of emanation.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: All-inclusive: everything is a manifestation of Consciousness, even pain, ignorance, and duality.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Consciousness has agency through its own free power (Shakti) and is the creative cause of the universe, which is Shiva's play (līlā).
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Multiplicity is a real feature of one Consciousness expressing itself, not a defect to overcome, so unity and diversity coexist.
core_claims_and_evidence: Shiva (Consciousness) and Shakti (power) are identical, and together they manifest as all reality.
The individual soul is identical with universal Consciousness; ignorance is forgetting this, and enlightenment is self-recognition.
The world is real and divine, unlike Advaita Vedanta's view of the world as ultimately unreal.
Ultimate Consciousness is self-aware and creative, unlike Advaita's passive, changeless Brahman.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Religious and philosophical tradition, scripture, and contemplative self-recognition.

empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Coherent as a non-dual idealism that keeps the world real by making Consciousness active and creative, which separates it from Advaita Vedanta's changeless Brahman and doctrine of Māyā.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since the individual soul is identical with universal Consciousness, which is the source of all forms, its real nature does not end with the body.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: The universe is Shiva's play, and human life finds its purpose in recognizing one's identity with divine Consciousness.
